summary: Assign existing roles as code with ansible.platform.role_team_assignment (team, assignment_objects with name and type organizations, role_definition) and ansible.platform.role_user_assignment (user, object_ids, role_definition). With tokens, replace aap_username and aap_password with aap_token in each task.
questions: How do I assign a role to a team with ansible.platform?
How do I assign an organization role to a user as code?

answer_card.title: Assign roles with ansible.platform
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.platform.role_team_assignment:
    team: "{{ team_name }}"
    assignment_objects:
      - name: "{{ org_name }}"
        type: organizations
    role_definition: "Organization Inventory Admin"
    state: present
- ansible.platform.role_user_assignment:
    user: "{{ user_username }}"
    object_ids: ["{{ org_name }}"]
    role_definition: "Organization Auditor"
    state: present
```
Add the `aap_hostname` and credentials (or `aap_token`) to each task.
